[EN] Thanks to you people have food and sleep well.

But we don't have any weapons to defend ourselves from unexpected attacks. Can you gather some weapons for us?"From where?"
[ES] Gracias a ti, la gente tiene comida y duerme bien.

Pero no tenemos armas para defendernos de ataques inesperados. ¿Puedes conseguirnos algunas armas?"From where?"

[EN] You should have passed by some nagas near the mine to the west.

Please collect weapons from those nagas.
[ES] Deberías haber pasado junto a algunos nagas cerca de la mina hacia el oeste.

Por favor, recolecta armas de esos nagas.

[EN] We're finally armed. That's a relief.

Now it's time to get rid of anything that threatens us.
[ES] Por fin estamos armados. Qué alivio.

Ahora es hora de deshacernos de cualquier cosa que nos amenace.

[EN] Please, we need those weapons.
[ES] Por favor, necesitamos esas armas.
